decisions.rationale: First GZHAN supplies the otherness expressed by else; someone and the possessive are explanatory framing. Do not assign it to the later repeated another person reference.
The first explicit wife is directly attested CHUNG MA. The later negative another-person wife is an anaphoric repetition, not a third Tibetan wife.
This DANG joins the prohibited partner categories and owns the first or, before the alternative woman description.
Standalone MIN owns the explicit not in the concession about another person’s wife; DE is anaphoric rather than a new name.
The concessive YANG directly attests although; preserve its local clause and do not merge it with the later even-if condition.
RANG is the self to whom the prohibited relatives belong, explicitly oneself in the expanded kinship framing. The subsequent his mother is its possessive resumption, not another RANG occurrence.
This MA is the mother noun, not the negative MA in the later improper conditions.
DANG after mother supplies the next list or. Raw SRID MO/sister is deliberately unbanked pending the spelling question.
DANG after the raw sister form supplies the next relative-category or; retain exact sequence despite the spelling omission.

Parental ancestry and lineage jointly give generations, while BDUN supplies seven. Preserve the complete ancestral-count phrase because PHA MA has glossary generations and RGYUD has lineage references; do not arbitrarily give the sole generations word to both. Past remains outside this tight phrase.
The whole limiting formula directly attests up to. Keep DU within its established formula.
The explicit relationship verb directly attests related, selecting the second English related beside female and the seven-generation limit.

NYE DU is the attested kin/relative word, recast predicatively as closely related. The earlier kinship qualification is separate from the later BREL BA/related; supplied too and to oneself remain outside this word. This contextual adjective correspondence is provisional.
The nominal female MO is a complete source syllable with direct female attestation. No larger NYE DU MO parent has consumed it; do not confuse it with the omitted MO inside SRID MO.
The second RANG is the self whose wife is being described, rendered the apostrophe-delimited one. Its possessive morphology is not a new allowed subword.
Second source CHUNG MA maps the third printed wife, the one’s-own-wife case. Explicit English order passes the anaphoric negative-wife repetition.
The whole concessive formula YIN YANG directly attests even if; it is grammatical depth6, not a lexical compound justified solely by a dictionary listing.
YAN LAG supplies part; explanatory of her body is not absorbed into the lexical head.
The complete negative-eligibility construction owns improper for the body-part condition. This is a phrase, not a dictionary-word promotion of the copula or a positive proper interior cut.
KHA directly attests mouth; possessive her remains outside.
DANG after KHA owns the anatomical-alternative or.
The complete attested GSHANG LAM maps anus. No narrower member can own the same entire English word; GSHANG alone has an empty scaffold.
YUL directly attests place in this location condition; no object-of-mind sense is substituted.
Second complete negative-eligibility phrase owns the second improper, the place condition.

The complete visibility/with-appearance construction is rendered out in the open in this location definition. SNANG BA has curated appearance and separate visibility/light references; no invented SNANG/open word pair is claimed. The contextual whole phrase remains provisional.
The complete technical shrine noun directly attests shrine; exclude the article.
This DANG joins the two sacred-place examples and supplies their or.
The whole compound directly attests temple, preserving the original ACIP GTZUG/Wylie gtsug transcription conventions.
The whole spatial formula directly attests in the environs of. Treat it as the complete locative expression at depth6; do not split a second of claim from the preceding genitive.
This DANG links the place and time conditions, rendered the explicit and before item4. Other list DANG forms without unique English connectors remain unbanked.
DUS supplies time in the final condition, not an arbitrary later period or while occurrence.
Third complete negative-eligibility phrase owns the time-specific improper.

Breast-milk drinking is the complete predicate behind nursing. NU ZHO has an empty HGM scaffold with milk-related reference material, while THUNG BA directly attests drink. The full local clause supports the whole phrase; neither an invented milk exponent nor a bare drink/nursing word pair is banked.
The first time-condition DANG supplies or between nursing and pregnancy. While/when and subjects are explanatory framing.
The whole printed SBRUM PA directly attests pregnant. No spelling replacement is made.
The next DANG supplies the pregnancy/observance alternative or.
The complete technical BSNYEN GNAS glossary explicitly gives one-day layman’s vow. Preserve the printed straight apostrophe and hyphen; the article is excluded.

GNAS PA describes abiding in/keeping the vow, locally observing. Its glossary keeping/maintains supports that predicate. SPYAD also has an observing gloss, but CHA SPYAD NA governs acting in these conditions; it is not assigned the same vow-observance exponent merely from that gloss.

The final explicit misconduct term is recast in the English introduction to the list. It is the only such term in this source segment; no introductory four/types words are invented from the previous row. The causal/classifying predicate remains separately unbanked.
